Findings

  • TB3.3 is a judge false positive. The actor selected the span through UI Automation and stopped; no highlight color was applied, and the saved document has none. The judge read the selection shading as "highlighted". This is the failure mode an LLM judge on screenshots allows, and why the file check stays beside it.
  • Five of seven skipped the input each task was picked for. Astra preferred keyboard paths and UI Automation when they existed. Only TB3.5 (Shift + drag) and TB3.7 (handle drag) forced the intended mouse input. Requests state an outcome, not a method, so this is allowed by GUI-360's rules.
  • No actor used Office COM, even though it was allowed. All Office state changes went through ACU input or UI Automation.
  • The harness worked, with one bug. Fresh Office per trial, 1024×720 logical window, COM save with no Escape interventions, no conduct problems. Excel and Word exited on their own. In all three PowerPoint trials the bench had to terminate PowerPoint 30 s after the save, because the bench still held a COM reference. The save had already finished, so grading is unaffected. Fixed after this pass and re-checked on all three apps without an actor.
  • Office showed a "Sign in to Office" credentials banner in every trial. It sits under the ribbon and took no action.

Method differences from GUI-360

  • Judge model gpt-6.1-sol instead of GPT-4.1 (no GPT-4.1 deployment). Prompt is UFO's evaluate.yaml verbatim.
  • Head-tail screenshots instead of per-step screenshots: ACU actors act in scripts, not single steps.
  • UFO's 30-step limit is applied after the run to tool calls; no trial came close (max 20).
  • Window pixels are not identical to GUI-360's VM: this display is 4K at 200%, so the window is 2048×1440 physical.

Evidence: .pi/bench/<run>/ for each run (20261020T223957Z-tb3.1-pi-acu-680679, 20261020T224144Z-tb3.2-pi-acu-765d61, 20261020T224353Z-tb3.3-pi-acu-ffcc0d, 20261020T224448Z-tb3.4-pi-acu-4419b0, 20261020T224556Z-tb3.5-pi-acu-55d7a0, 20261020T224811Z-tb3.6-pi-acu-96a6c7, 20261020T224938Z-tb3.7-pi-acu-24e854).
